execution_capture.command_format: Exact argv arrays supplied to subprocess.run; no shell interpretation is implied.
execution_capture.timestamps: UTC recorded immediately before and after each subprocess; concurrent records may overlap.
execution_capture.log_capture: stdout followed by stderr, not a globally ordered interleaving. Ledger retains exact arguments, timestamps, exits, test totals, relevant failure excerpts and raw-log SHA-256 digests.
execution_capture.filesystem: Execution occurred in the agent workspace, not on the owner’s Dell/WSL/Windows computer.

baseline.evidence_kind: Fresh starting checkout with clean npm ci; no existing installation reused.

command: import json,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; p=json.loads(Path("package.json").read_text()); b=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:package.json"])); lock=json.loads(Path("package-lock.json").read_text()); assert p["private"] and "main" not in p; assert p["version"]==b["version"]==lock["version"]=="1.0.0"; assert p["dependencies"]==b["dependencies"]==lock["packages"][""]["dependencies"]; assert p["devDependencies"]==b["devDependencies"]==lock["packages"][""]["devDependencies"]; subprocess.run(["git","diff","--exit-code","HEAD","--","package-lock.json"],check=True); print("Application metadata corrected; version, dependencies and lockfile unchanged.")

expected_diagnostics: Intentional cancellation/failure probes may print workerd diagnostics already present in the starting baseline. Host proxy/npm notices are environment output, distinct from failed tests or browser application errors.
limitations: Local workerd/browser verification does not establish a deployed Cloudflare service or global routing behavior.
Todo access remains disabled in the deployable configuration; a public demo needs separately reviewed access policy and delivery authorization.
Minimal SQLite persistence does not supply production backup, restore, disaster recovery or schema-upgrade acceptance.
Reconnect recovers current committed state, not exactly-once event history; uncertain mutations are not automatically replayed.
No heartbeat or bounded idle-partition detection is provided after the first snapshot; retry exhaustion requires explicit recovery.
Application queue/snapshot bounds exclude platform/socket/browser internal buffers; local measurements do not establish production capacity.
Optional native-browser tooling is not added to repository dependencies or required by normal CI.
Project roadmap upload is not performed by a Git commit or the prepared reference copy.
